summary: Drivers workspace v1 source transport now carries an optional fsgg.owner-guidance/1 descriptor and a body-only .fsgg/atlas-guidance.md fragment staged directly from the authored Atlas root-guidance.md reference. The manual Python helper reads that same reference and wraps it in the existing atlas markers. The declaration targets claude and codex and requires the policy plus the skill, helper and reference in both current skill roots; a compatible receiver must verify selected workspace and driver-skill bytes before activation. The unchanged stager and focused source fixtures verify staged digests, manual block agreement, preserved authored Unicode prose and historical-seed retrieval. This source contract adds no execution hook or workspace manifest version and does not change the separate SDD Knowledge API. It establishes neither generic SDD implementation nor publication, installed fresh scaffold, retained doctor/upgrade acceptance or fleet adoption; those remain separate receiver/release outcomes.
title: Atlas owner payload shares one guidance body across manual and declarative routes
